fee_notes: Single Salon Initial Franchise Fee is $39,500. Fast Start Program Development Fee is $69,500 for 3-Salon and $99,500 for 6-Salon development rights; $10,000 for each additional Salon beyond 6. New franchisees (or existing franchisees signing a Development Agreement after September 29, 2011) pay no separate initial franchise fee — the Development Fee covers all development and franchise rights. During the last fiscal year, Development Fees ranged from $0 to $39,500. Fees are non-refundable. Existing franchisees who joined before September 30, 2011 pay a lower Development Fee per Salon plus separate franchise fees.
